wayland_explorer.about: Wayland protocol support per compositor, from https://github.com/vially/wayland-explorer (MIT). Keys are our compositor ids, values are wayland-explorer's file names.

hyprland_hall_of_fame.about: Winners of Hyprland's ricing contests, from the Hyprland website's source (https://github.com/hyprwm/hyprland-website, BSD-3-Clause). Screenshots stay on hypr.land and belong to each rice's author.
